title: OutlookAttachmentReference
description: Metadata for one attachment. The bytes are fetched separately through the binary transfer profile, so any-size attachments stay out of the JSON-RPC body.

mimeType.description: MIME type. Embedded messages are reported as message/rfc822.

contentId.description: Content-ID for an inline attachment, without angle brackets.

isInline.description: True when the attachment is referenced from the message body by contentId.

kind.description: Implementation-defined attachment kind. Known values include binary and embeddedMessage.

sizeBytes.description: Exact length of the transferable bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the transferable bytes.

transferHandle.description: Opaque handle for GET /erato/sidecar/transfer/v1/{handle} within the same sidecar runtime.
